## Problem and change

Explain why this change is needed and the resulting behavior. Link the SN task and any requirement/ADR.

## Validation

State what actually ran, the result, and what remains untested. Include versions and report links for real-backend work.

## Scope and risks

Describe compatibility, numerical/temporal assumptions, security, licensing, and classroom-schedule implications when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] All added project text is in English.
- [ ] Repository check and relevant implementation checks passed.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unreviewed third-party assets are included.
- [ ] Documentation, task status, and ADRs are updated where needed.
- [ ] Implemented behavior is distinguished from proposals and mocks.
